text.description_html:
Grandeur PSHNOS-OB, 3 x 13-7/8 Oil Rubbed Bronze New Orleans Push Plate

The New Orleans Push Plate is based on the Russwin design from the early 1900's. It was and still is very popular in the French Quarter of New Orleans's jazz clubs, restaurants and high end homes. The rope border and ornate detailing make this one of the most elegant pushplates available today. The New Orleans 3 x 13-7/8 Push Plate is cast in high quality brass and finished in Oil Rubbed Bronze. It is packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Click here to see the entire Grandeur Nostalgic Warehouse Collection

Specifications of the Small New Orleans 3 x 13-7/8 Solid Brass Push Plate:

  • Width: 3"
  • Height: 13-7/8"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only 2 Left.
